primary_interest.quote: We want a voice AI support agent.

use_case.quote: We want a voice AI support agent. Drivers and customers call in to ask where a shipment is, reschedule a delivery, report a problem.

inference_framing.quote: I'm not looking to buy an LLM API as its own thing. But if it's part of the agent, fine.

inference_raised_by.quote: For a voice agent to work, you need an LLM behind it, and we host that inference ourselves.

competitors_inference.quote: We've been testing Fireworks for the model side, so we do have a comparison.

competitors_voice.quote: Twilio, for the human call center. We've also looked at Sinch for the AI side.

decision_criteria.quote: So there's a gap, and I'll be upfront about it.

stated_reason.quote: About $0.71 per million tokens. Your number came back at about $1.08. So there's a gap, and I'll be upfront about it.
